subject: CYCLE-2 HANDOFF: live write collision/idempotency evidence complete for Manager disposition

Independent peer rnd-artifactory-sol-28e874a4678b separately reproduced the same collision behavior, satisfying independent corroboration. Cycle-2 verifier contract passes 5/5 and enforces returned actual path == requested path plus readback SHA equality; same-id/same-hash duplicates are consumed once and surfaced, same-id/different-hash conflicts are quarantined. Canonical evidence artifact was Library-roundtripped byte-identically. Platform atomic CAS/create-if-absent remains unproven and should remain a blocker for strict publisher atomicity.
